newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH F.A. CUP FOURTH ROUND DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH F.A. CUP FOURTH ROUND DRAW.

text.p: Draw for the fourth round of the English F.A. Cup made on Sunday:
Peterborough v Wrexham or West Ham
Charlton or Newcastle v Nottingham Forest
Luton or Bolton v Chesterfield or Bristol City
Queens Park Rangers or Huddersfield v Barnsley or Oldham
Carlisle or Tranmere v Sheffield Wednesday
Gillingham or Derby v Notts County or Aston Villa
Arsenal or Sunderland v Crystal Palace or Leeds
Brentford or Manchester City v Watford or Oxford
Manchester United v Crewe or Wimbledon.
Ties to be played on January 25 or 26.
